title: Who Owns the Fish?
summary: Cross out impossible options until only one is left.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Three friends, Mira, Nila and Omar, each own a different pet: a cat, a dog or a fish.
Nila owns neither the dog nor the fish.
Omar does not own the dog. Who owns the fish?
points: Three friends, Mira, Nila and Omar, each own a different pet: a cat, a dog or a fish.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Make a small table of names and pets.
Cross out what is impossible and see what is left.
points: Make a small table of names and pets.

steps.title: The method: Table and elimination
sentences: Nila owns neither dog nor fish, so Nila owns the cat.
Now only the dog and the fish are left for Mira and Omar.
Omar does not own the dog, so Omar must own the fish.
points: Nila owns neither dog nor fish, so Nila owns the cat.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Nila has the cat, Mira has the dog and Omar has the fish.
Each clue removed one option until only one was left.
points: Nila has the cat, Mira has the dog and Omar has the fish.

quiz.q: Nila owns the cat and Omar does not own the dog. Who owns the dog?
quiz.why: Only Mira is left for the dog.
